name: Echo run lifecycle and observer merged
instruction: A TaskFlow progress comment for the Echo agent-harness build task.

content.body: Added addressable in-memory run lifecycle endpoints on main: POST/GET/DELETE under /v1/sessions/{id}/runs with run.started and run.interrupted event publication. Integrated Sable's observer primitives and corrected them to emit the standard `message` SSE event rather than a new event name. Observer now includes Claude/Codex transcript path helpers, external session id extraction, defensive JSONL parsing, offset dedupe, and event-bus publication. Verification on main: uv run pytest -> 22 passed; specs/openapi.yaml parses; drift scan found no disallowed /v1/runs, /archive, /interrupt, backend_id, tool_call, succeeded, cancelled, or message.observed references.
